settings.title: School settings
settings.readOnly: Only the school admin can change these settings. You can see them here.
settings.noAccess: School settings are available to school admins and coordinators.
settings.saveError: We couldn't save the settings. Please try again.
settings.leaveBody: You have changes that aren't saved yet.
settings.openDimensionsHint: Wording, weights and order of the session ratings
settings.openDataRequestsHint: Parents' requests to download or delete data

details.title: School details
details.body: Shown to staff and parents of your school.
details.name: School name
details.shortNameHelp: Used where space is tight, e.g. “Sunrise CDC”
details.logoHelp: A square image works best. It appears on reports and in the app.
details.logoError: We couldn't open your photos. Please try again.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.body: When families and therapists get appointment reminders.
reminders.none: No appointment reminders will be sent.
reminders.quietBody: No notifications in this time. They arrive when quiet hours end.

parents.title: Parents
parents.numericScore: Show the Session Score number to parents
parents.whyWords: We suggest keeping this off. Parents see plain words and arrows, like “Focus: better than last time ↑”. A single number can worry families on an off day and isn't meant for comparing children.
parents.checkinHelp: On session days, parents are asked how the child slept, ate and feels. Therapists see it before the session.

videos.title: Practice videos
videos.help: Videos are deleted after this. Shorter is kinder to families' privacy.

calendar.title: Working hours and days
calendar.body: Appointments outside these times are flagged when booking.
calendar.holidaysBody: No sessions are booked on these days.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.body: When coordinators are told a child may need attention.
alerts.drop: Score drop that raises an alert
alerts.dropHelp: Compared with the child's recent average for that therapy.

logs.title: Session logs
logs.help: After this, changes need a reason and are kept in the history.

errors.shortNameLong: Keep the short name under 25 characters.
errors.workingHours: Closing time must be after opening time.
errors.workingDays: Choose at least one working day.
errors.quietHours: Start and end can't be the same.

dimensions.title: Rating scales
dimensions.intro: Clear anchors keep scoring consistent when therapists change.
dimensions.introBody: Every session is rated on these scales from 1 to 5. Each number has a short description, so two therapists would score the same session the same way.
dimensions.weightHelp: Higher weight counts more in the Session Score.
dimensions.minEnabled: Keep at least 3 scales on so the Session Score stays meaningful.
dimensions.saveError: We couldn't save that change. Please try again.
dimensions.label: Name for staff
dimensions.previewHint: Tap a number to see its description, as therapists will.
dimensions.resetDone: Default wording restored. Save to keep it.
dimensions.readOnly: Only the school admin can change rating scales.

therapyTypes.title: Therapy types
therapyTypes.intro: The therapies your school offers. Each has a colour and icon used as a small marker in calendars and reports.
therapyTypes.inactiveNote: Turned-off types can't be booked. Past sessions stay as they are.
therapyTypes.name: Name
therapyTypes.nameTaken: There is already a therapy type with this name.
therapyTypes.saveError: We couldn't save the therapy type. Please try again.
therapyTypes.readOnly: Only the school admin can change therapy types.

dataRequests.title: Data requests
dataRequests.intro: Parents can ask to download their child's data or to have it deleted. Track each request here until it is done.
dataRequests.deletionNote: Deleting a child's data can't be undone. An admin should check with the family, export anything the school must keep, and delete carefully before marking it done.
dataRequests.confirmDeletionBody: Only do this after {{child}}'s data has been deleted.
dataRequests.updateError: We couldn't update the request. Please try again.
dataRequests.emptyBody: When a parent asks to download or delete their child's data, it will appear here.
dataRequests.readOnly: Only the school admin can update requests.
